title: Chat tab on every session page: talk to any session from its page
description: Owner (2026-10-26): the session page has no chat. He wants a Chat tab (probably first) that embeds the dictation chat widget (Chat v2, ux/Dictate) on any session page, so he can click back into any past session and talk to it, and see its Prompts as bubbles with their Questions and answers. Prompts then leave the Tasks tab, which holds real work only. Open design questions: does talking to an old session wake its smart seat (or resume it), and how it relates to the Switch session dropdown. Related: the Overview task, where Prompts are unclickable and show as raw ids.
